prompts.frog: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character sprite, single original frog launcher, transparent PNG, square canvas. Create a stunning entirely original Maya-inspired fantasy frog guardian: deep turquoise jade skin with dark obsidian spots, sculptural broad head, brilliant amber eyes at left and right, articulated powerful hind legs, modest hammered bronze ornaments and geometric jade inlays. Painterly high-end hand-painted game art with crisp silhouette, tactile material and controlled detail readable at 140 pixels. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN camera, no side or isometric view. Frog centered at (50%,50%), facing exactly UP. Symmetrical balanced silhouette, legs fit within central 85% of canvas. Head and mouth at upper central portion, a dark round marble-launching mouth socket centered at (50%,27%) so a separately drawn ball can sit there. No ball in mouth, no base or ground, no drop shadow beyond silhouette, no scenery, no lettering, no logos. Original invented ornament inspired by stepped fretwork, NOT a copy of a character from any existing game. Soft upper-left light, refined jade blue-green and warm bronze palette. Genuine transparent background. No sheet, no multiple poses, one beautiful complete frog.
prompts.marbles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exact production 2D rolling marble SPRITE SHEET, transparent PNG, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 by 1024 pixels. EXACT GRID: 8 columns and 4 rows, 32 equal square cells, NO gutters, NO exterior padding, NO text or labels. Every sphere sits exactly at the center of its own cell, identical diameter 80% of cell width, full sphere visible with transparent area around it. Four original Maya-inspired enchanted stone marble designs: row 1 red cinnabar with ivory angular SUN medallion and dark red stepped-fret bands; row 2 bright turquoise with pale wave/serpent curved inlay; row 3 golden amber with dark ochre three-leaf/star inlay; row 4 lush emerald with pale jade diamond/leaf relief. Clearly different strong saturated colors and motifs recognizable at 32 pixels. Each row is ONE identical sphere rotating through EIGHT equally spaced rolling frames, 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 degrees around horizontal axis, for a seamless forward rolling animation. Motif surface markings move over sphere and disappear around the back as it rolls; geometry never moves inside its cell. Camera stays fixed, soft upper-left highlight remains fixed in all frames. Painted 3D spherical volume, lustrous stone, restrained small highlights, elegant bold engraved motifs. Entirely original designs, do not imitate any existing game assets. Strict regular grid and consistent sphere sizes are essential. No board, no character, no shadows outside each sphere, no fake transparency checkerboard; actual transparent background.
prompts.temple: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 background plate for a top-down marble shooter, no gameplay pieces. Create an extraordinary original hand-painted Maya-inspired fantasy temple floor, true straight-down orthographic view. A dark weathered blue-green limestone courtyard, subtly patterned large irregular stone slabs and fine moss in cracks; CENTRAL 80% MUST BE QUIET, LOW CONTRAST AND RELATIVELY EMPTY for separately rendered spiral track and colorful marbles. Rich art concentrated at far left and far right edge and lower corners: stepped stone architectural reliefs, intricate original geometric fretwork borders, carved invented sun and serpent imagery, aged bronze and jade inset accents, ferns encroaching into corners. Top 15% remains dark and subdued behind readable game HUD. At center leave plain subtly textured stone, no altar, no center focal illustration, no rings, no track, no holes, no frog, no balls, no items, no text, no UI, no vignette obscuring central play area. Refined adventurous archaeological fantasy mood, beautiful painted material textures with restrained directional lighting, muted dark green slate ground so luminous red turquoise gold green marbles read strongly. Original invented artwork with broad Maya-inspired architectural cues, not a reproduction of any real monument, symbol transcription, or existing game artwork. Landscape full-bleed opaque image.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Four separate complete circular objects, each perfectly centered in its quadrant with diameter 80% of quadrant width, camera straight down orthographic. TOP LEFT: low round aged bronze-and-jade frog pedestal with geometric radial stepped-fret carving, flat round jade center, no frog. TOP RIGHT: marble entrance gate, circular limestone ring carved with original turquoise serpent-like abstract motifs and tiny golden inlays, BLACK open circular hole in center. BOTTOM LEFT: marble exit gate, circular chipped obsidian-and-gold ring with invented amber SUN teeth and a deep black hole with a restrained hot red center, distinct silhouette and warm coloring. BOTTOM RIGHT: small round engraved decorative stone medallion, muted brass abstract four-petal/stepped diamond geometry, flat quiet center. Cohesive hand-painted premium fantasy game art, turquoise limestone bronze jade palette, soft fixed upper-left light, crisp silhouettes and readable carvings at 80 pixels. Background truly transparent, no ground, no cast shadow outside objects. No characters, no balls, no letters, no copied game designs, no collage frame. These are newly invented Maya-inspired ornaments, not replicas of any historical glyph or existing game asset. Four evenly spaced props in strict 2x2 grid.
